newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SQUASH-AUSTRALIA'S DRADY-HARTE MAKES EMPHATIC COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-AUSTRALIA'S DRADY-HARTE MAKES EMPHATIC COMEBACK.

text.p: Ex-world number two Danielle Drady-Harte marked her return to top-level competition with an emphatic 14-minute victory over Dutch player Daphne Jeigersma in the first round of the women's World Open on Tuesday.
The Australian surrendered only two points on her way to brushing aside Jeigersma 9-1 9-1 9-0 in Petaling Jaya, just outside the Malaysian capital.
Drady-Harte is making a comeback after having a child.

A couple of years back she was close friends with current world number one Michelle Martin and completed the family squash story by marrying Michelle's older brother Rodney, who was then the men's world champion.
The story turned sour when the women fell out over their relationships with commercial manager Phil Harte. Danielle split from Rodney to set up both business and private life with Harte.
Michelle, aiming for a fourth successive world title, was opening her campaign against South African qualifier Angelique Clifton Parks later on Tuesday.
